title: Special Thanks

blocks.text: This guide would not exist without the contributions and support of a lot of people. As such, I wanted to give everyone the credit they very much deserve in this section. Again, thank you to everyone who contributed in some way to this guide.

These people have made other great FAQs on this website that my guide was based off of. Without any of the findings from these individuals this guide would have never been made. Please support these people in any way possible.
Huge thanks to Cliff K. for spotting and pointing out a bunch of typos and errors!

There are two individuals who are good friends of mine and have supported me throughout the creation of this guide. I will not name them for the sake of their privacy, but if they are reading this then they know who they are. Thank you to both of you for the support, both in this project and in other projects I am currently working on.

Last but most certainly not least. If you have read any portion of this guide then you have made my time spent on this worthwhile, whether you loved it, hated it, or fall somewhere in between. Lots of people have reached out to me and have caught errors and made suggestions to improve this guide. To everyone who has messaged me, recommended this guide, used it for their playthrough, or just read through it, thank you for all of your support.
